invisible_bit_explanation: 109 target_delta_16dq bits are NOT visible in our minimal Gowin micro-corpus. They are likely activated only in EXP_HH-context: SDRAM-DQ multi-bit-bus + specific clock spine + bidirectional registered output + PLL clock domain. Surfacing them would require corpus designs that replicate that context (multi-bit IOBUF arrays clocked from a PLL with explicit synchronous read+write timing). Currently parked.
